title: Grateful Dead Live at Lanai Theater on 1969-11-15

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear 1969 soundboard captures an epic Pigpen‑driven set with a 42‑minute Turn On Your Lovelight and tight harmonies on Casey Jones.
ai_review.review: The recording is an excellent vintage soundboard tape – warm, deep and surprisingly clear for the era, with a pleasant scooped EQ that tames the usual vocal over‑emphasis. Musically the show shines thanks to Pigpen’s organ‑heavy numbers and a monster 42‑minute Turn On Your Lovelight, while the band’s harmonies on Casey Jones are crystal‑clear, making it a must‑have for any 1969 Grateful Dead collection.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers gave high marks (5,5,5,4) and praised both the performance (standout Pigpen material and Lovelight) and the soundboard quality; weighting favors the strong show, yielding an overall rating near 4.7.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp harmonies, warm deep tone, reasonable clarity for a 1969 SBD; scooped EQ helps balance vocals and instruments, minimal brittleness noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set feels like an authentic 1969 Dead show – raw and carefree, with tighter Pigpen‑led numbers and new Workingman's Dead material that keep the energy high throughout.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen's organ is prominent on several songs, giving a gritty blues edge to the performance.
